#!/bin/sh
set -e
# kapanis gunluk ozeti
gun=${1:-$(date +%Y%m%d)}
out=/data/giden/kapanis_${gun}.txt
echo "kapanis ${gun} satir=$(ls /data/giden | wc -l)" > "$out"
echo "uretildi: $out"
